## Summary
Describe the observed behavior.

## Reproduction
1. Workspace and input values (synthetic/public data only)
2. Expected output
3. Actual output

## Environment
Browser, operating system, screen size and language.

## Evidence
Screenshots, formulas, links to public references or test cases.

**Important:** Do not include confidential manufacturer, employer or customer specifications.
